conclusion: No blocker found in the per-candidate transaction fix. Exception propagation, full notification-write rollback, thread isolation and real cross-process reindex exclusion verified on disposable databases.
limits: No full suite rerun, production writes or network.
Trace, flush, report and other operations after candidate commit remain outside this reservation; no claim of universal concurrency safety.
An exception deliberately caught inside candidate_transaction is not automatically a rollback-only marker; reviewed Pipeline lets persistence exceptions escape.
